summary: Scene-graph vertex clustering for LOD generation. Zeroes four per-cluster work slots, selects a working scene-graph child, counts vertices per cluster by nearest reference position (block at this+0x150, 74-dword stride), allocates per-cluster packed arrays, then writes each vertex into its cluster array with a projected normal and a clamped LOD blend weight. Called by VehicleGraphicsSceneLoader.

operations.description: Initialize local sentinels for per-vertex nearest-distance tracking (FLT_MAX-style values, 2139095039) and reset the found-cluster index.

Cluster init loop over the 4 cluster work slots (74-dword stride starting at this+125 dwords): zero the per-cluster array pointer at this+0x1F4 and the slot at this+0x1F8, saving a copy of each cluster entry's first dword (block at this+0x150) into this+0x1F8.
Read the scene-graph node pointer this[548] (this+0x890) and clear the found-child slot this[569] (this+0x8E4) to 0.
Only proceed when the scene-graph node pointer at this+0x890 is non-null.
Call SceneGraphChildCount on the scene-graph node to obtain its child count.

Iterate the children, fetching each child via LinkedListIndexedAccessor_c230; select the first child whose vertex position value (child+244 dwords) is zero (zero-threshold test, global flt_59E440) and store it as the working node at this+0x8E4.
Only proceed when a working child node was found (this+0x8E4 non-null).
Call PackedArrayTotalSize on the working node to get the total vertex count v39.

First vertex pass: fetch each vertex via PackedArrayIndexLookup, compute squared 3D distance to each of the 4 cluster reference positions (block at this+0x150), and record the nearest cluster plus a running minimum |x| used to size the LOD radius.
Increment the nearest cluster's vertex tally (the per-cluster count block alongside this+0x1F4) and update the cluster's minimum |x| value.
Replace the per-cluster distance sentinels (1036831949) with small initial radius values before array allocation.
Allocation loop over 4 clusters: call OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(32 * clusterCount) and store the returned packed-array pointer at the cluster's this+0x1F4 slot.

Second vertex pass: re-fetch each vertex via PackedArrayIndexLookup, recompute its nearest cluster by 3D distance to the reference block at this+0x150, write x/y/z into the cluster's packed array (32-byte stride, offset by current count at this+0x1F4 region), project the vertex onto the cluster transform rows to build a normal at +12..+20, and store the source vertex pointer at +28.

Compute the per-vertex LOD blend weight at +24 from |x| against the cluster's minimum |x| with a small slack term (0.090000004 literal); global flt_5AD15C is read as a threshold in this vertex/LOD pipeline.
